bosses.name: The Ashen Sentinel
bosses.title: Warden of the Fallen Courtyard
bosses.intro: A gate sergeant. They told him the post was for one winter.

phases.roar: The Sentinel's armour splits. Embers pour from the seams.
He plants the blade and speaks the oath of the gate one last time.

bosses.name: The Hollow Executioner
bosses.title: Last Justice of the Blackwood
bosses.intro: The sentences were all passed long ago. He is only catching up.

phases.roar: He drags the cleaver through the roots. Something under the wood answers.
He stops, sets the cleaver down, and recites a name. It is not yours. He picks the cleaver up again.

bosses.name: The Crimson Widow
bosses.title: Commander of the Last Rising
bosses.intro: She led the rising against the Everbound. Something of theirs has kept her alive to regret it.

phases.roar: She tears the feed line from her collar. Whatever has been keeping her alive, she is done owing it.

bosses.name: The Cathedral Beast
bosses.title: Keeper of the Lower Works
bosses.intro: It was made to keep what lies under the cathedral. Nobody remembers telling it to stop.

phases.roar: The bell above tolls once, by itself. The Beast rises onto two legs.

bosses.name: The Gravewarden
bosses.title: Keeper of the Sunken Crypt
bosses.intro: He knows what is kept down here, and he has been gentle with it for a very long time.

phases.roar: The water rises to your knees. Under it, row on row, the storage lamps come on.
He turns his back on you for a moment and lays a hand on the nearest tomb. Then he turns round.

bosses.name: The Frostbound King
bosses.title: Sovereign of the Frozen Citadel
bosses.intro: One of the first to live forever. He tried to stop. This was as close as he could get.

phases.roar: Frost climbs the walls. Your breath hangs in front of you and stays there.
The seals he froze himself behind give way. He looks almost relieved.

bosses.name: The Forgotten Monarch
bosses.title: Steward of the Crown
bosses.intro: He was never a king. He was the one left to keep the machines running.

phases.roar: The steward stands up from the machine at last. Every light in the hall turns to follow him.
The Crown burns white. He is no longer running the machine. It is running him.

bosses.name: The Pale Huntsman
bosses.title: He Who Follows
bosses.intro: You heard him three trees back. He let you.

phases.roar: He wipes the axe on his sleeve and steps back among the trees. You lose him for a moment.

bosses.name: Veyrath, the Cinder Wyrm
bosses.title: The Siege That Outlived Its War
bosses.intro: Built to break sieges, and woken under the mountain when there was nothing left to besiege.

phases.roar: She takes the air. The roost drops away beneath her and the wind turns hot.
Her wing is torn through. She will not fly again. She does not need to.

bosses.name: Skeldra, the White Ruin
bosses.title: What the King Kept Chained
bosses.intro: The chain froze through an age ago. It stayed anyway. It had been told to.

phases.roar: The chain snaps. It looks at the broken link for a long moment, and then at you.

bosses.name: Azhurion, the Last Wing
bosses.title: The Oldest Thing They Built
bosses.intro: Part animal, part armour, part engine. It was the first, and nobody ever wrote down how to stop it.

phases.roar: Plates along its spine lift and lock. Something inside it changes gear.
The engine in its chest is failing. It fights like something that knows it is the last.

bosses.name: The Devourer of Names
bosses.title: What the Crown Discarded
bosses.intro: Every mind the Crown threw away, in one body. It would like, very much, to be someone.

phases.roar: It opens. Inside it is every face it has taken. Some of them know you.
It falls, and is still. Then it says a name in a voice you know from the inside, and stands.

variants.name: Royal Gatekeeper
variants.title: Of the King's Own Door
variants.intro: He was posted at the door the day the hall was finished. He has shown many wardens to the gate.

variants.name: The Forgotten Monarch
variants.title: The Last Defense of the Crown
variants.reason: The network restores him while it runs.
variants.intro: The floor of the hall stands open. What kept him is no longer hidden under it.

phases.name: The Ancient Crown
phases.roar: Plates along his arms turn and lock. The crown was never the only machine he wore.

phases.name: The Last Defense
phases.roar: He falls. Under the floor the engines turn over, and stand him up again.

variants.name: The Awakened Beast
variants.title: What the Blackwood Kept Asleep
variants.reason: The Executioner's block stood empty for twenty-four years. Something older took the clearing.
variants.intro: The stumps have been pulled up like teeth. Whatever did it is still hungry.

variants.name: The Laboratory Guardian
variants.title: Bolted Into Its Post
variants.reason: The Beast's fall uncovered the lower door. This was behind it.
variants.intro: A door under the crossing, and the thing that was built to stand in it.

variants.name: The White Brood
variants.title: Skeldra's Get
variants.reason: Skeldra died in the pit. What she left there grew.
